immutable_rules.uniqueness: Every assertion id is globally unique; a duplicate, missing, unexpected, skipped, TODO, or multiply reported id fails the owning command.
immutable_rules.execution: Each command must emit exactly one terminal result for every assertion assigned to it and no other assertion ids.
immutable_rules.invalidation: Any manifest byte change invalidates the design verdict. Any source, config, dependency, migration, test, or gate change after execution invalidates all results.
immutable_rules.timeout: timeout_seconds is per assertion; timeout, transport error, missing credentials, or inability to set up is failure.
